title: Jesus... She Got The Promotion I Trained Her For 👏
topic: her best friend at work got the promotion she trained her for, and she clapped first while envy ate at her

bible.text: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my best friend got the promotion I trained her for. I clapped first. 👏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I taught her the reports. Now she's my lead. I smiled through the whole cake.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your hands clapped. Your heart kept score.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I'm a terrible friend for feeling this?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. You're being honest. Envy grows in the dark. Bring it to Me and it loosens its grip.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Her win took nothing from your worth.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who always claps first. 👏
